test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Armature and Coil Winder) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following steps is essential when configuring a web browser to enhance both security and privacy for a user?

options.text: Enabling pop-ups for all websites to improve user experience
Setting the homepage to a frequently visited website for quick access
Configuring the browser to block third-party cookies and enabling HTTPS-only mode
Disabling the browser's cache to improve website loading times

solution:
The correct answer is **3) Configuring the browser to block third-party cookies and enabling HTTPS-only mode.**

This option addresses the two most critical pillars of internet safety: **privacy** (controlling who tracks you) and **security** (ensuring your data is encrypted).
